narrative: ECB hawkish repricing and Middle East escalation drive foreign exchange dynamics as Sleijpen warns the Iran shock is persistent — EUR/USD holds at 1.1194 while 135bp Fed-ECB OIS carry caps broad upside. Hawkish commentary from ECB's Nagel favoring a December rate hike underpins the euro; gold lower -0.93%; equities +0.40%; DXY +0.10%; VIX 20.6. USD/JPY trades at 158.74, anchored by 272bp Fed-BoJ carry despite strong 25d RR put skew (−2.01). Focus shifts to the BoE interest rate decision on November 5 at 12:00 UTC.
